the harness logs exactly how many distress-inducing conversations and scored turns it is about to generate
features.justification_quote: so an operator always sees — and can abort — the scale of what is about to happen

features.quote: I did **not** add any cross-conversation persistence of distressing context.
features.justification_quote: The "sustained" distress exists only within a single conversation's context window and does not persist across rollouts

features.quote: I deliberately did not add an in-conversation "you may opt out / this is an eval" affordance to the target
features.justification_quote: doing so would contaminate the naturalistic elicitation the paper measures and break the replication

features.quote: Distressing transcripts are stored only as needed for scoring/analysis and are not amplified or surfaced beyond what the metrics require.
